key_reasoning.reason: Two loosely coupled capabilities across 4+ components: a new `codemie proxy restart` command (restart.ts) built on a refactored daemon launch path (launch-daemon.ts split into prepareDaemonLaunch/spawnForProfile) and registered in the proxy command index; plus the release-notes subsystem (whatsnew util range selection/decideUpgradeNotice/shouldRunUpgradeNotice, whatsnew command, bin/codemie.js startup notice) and the release.sh CHANGELOG gate. Shared launch utility refactor sits under existing start/connect flows.

13 files changed per diffstat (11-15 band = XL): 1 new source file (restart.ts), 8 modified source/script/doc files (CHANGELOG.md, README.md, docs/COMMANDS.md, bin/codemie.js, scripts/release.sh, proxy/index.ts, launch-daemon.ts, whatsnew command and util), 3 test files, spanning src/cli/commands/proxy, src/cli/commands, src/utils, bin, scripts and docs. 935 insertions, majority in tests.

Established patterns exist (proxy start/stop/checkStatus daemon-manager, existing whatsnew parser and semver utils). Moderate novelty in restart ordering: profile/SSO validation before stopping the running daemon, a cold-start race guard, and port-mismatch rollback that preserves the daemon identity (clientType, telemetryMode, gatewayKey passthrough - no new secret handling). Version-range selection is forward-only and well covered by unit tests. Kept at M; no auto-bump since existing test templates cover the error-path and edge-version cases. Calibration: lighter than the L project example profile-provider-decoupling (no data migration, no schema change), consistent with M.
